params.name: tickCount
params.description: Tickcount or -1=Trigger as soon as possible

sentinelValues.meaning: Activate the On Timer form event as soon as possible, i.e. as soon as the 4D application hands control back to the event manager (useful to ensure a form is fully displayed before further processing).

overloads.semanticRole: The SET TIMER command activates the On Timer form event and sets, for the current form and process, the number of ticks elapsed between each On Timer form event.

constraints: Applies to the current form and process; if called in a context where no form is displayed, it has no effect.
When called from a subform's form method, the On Timer event is generated in the subform, not the parent form.
